release_name: RAGF Social Ecology and Technology Genesis
primary_goal: Provide deterministic production seeds for a human-playable 2.5D AI society ecosystem game without LLM dependency.
changes: representative rule-based agents, households, institutions, factions and links
continuous history ledger with player branches
technology concept grammar across function, principle, substrate, energy, control and manufacturing
structured player technology proposals without LLM
epistemic_boundary: Generated future technologies are simulation hypotheses and require real-world scientific and engineering validation.
delivery_boundary: RAGF generation and deterministic simulation substrate; not yet the complete 2.5D game client.
